scope: Refresh independent DWG reader maturity and application-level route claims; refine optional peer admission without treating mutable aggregate claims as support evidence.

method.kind: Public project READMEs, status and provenance documents, and GNU LibreDWG class documentation
method.sourcePinning: Public repository master/main pages were inspected as discovery evidence; exact peer commits, package checksums, compiler/toolchain and runtime outputs were not captured. Any future executable comparison must pin them before use.
method.evidenceRule: Advertised version matrices, self-reported coverage, strict structural parsing, application opening, display tessellation, B-rep validity and native-CAD acceptance are distinct evidence layers.

evidence.topic: dwg-rs independent reader maturity and coverage-report consistency
evidence.observed: The project describes a spec-led Apache-2.0 Rust DWG implementation based on ODA v5.4.1 and labels itself pre-alpha. The README distinguishes a more mature container/object-stream walker from alpha entity decoders, partial graph resolution, no DXF parser, alpha DWG/DXF writers, and approximate glTF tessellation. It describes strict per-record endpoint checks and allocation caps. Its current README is internally inconsistent: the coverage table states 3,911 decoded, 525 skipped, 9 errored across 19 files (88.0%); a later verification paragraph states 90.3% aggregate and 85.9% for AC1032; and an earlier capability row still states 95.6%. The table gives the dated per-version denominators; the other figures appear to be stale snapshots.
doesNotEstablish: production readiness or broad per-entity semantic completeness
a stable aggregate coverage value from the mutable README
comparability with this repository's corpus or denominator
DXF reader support or DWG writer acceptance
ACIS/B-rep semantics or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep as an optional separate-implementation DWG structural and record-boundary comparator. At a composed checkpoint, pin exact source, dependency graph, Rust toolchain and executable; run the coverage report on exact overlapping already-admitted local inputs; preserve raw report and corpus/input hashes; capture per-version/per-family decoded, skipped, errored and boundary-checked denominators. Do not use the conflicting README percentages as a parity score. Treat endpoint checking as a test-design lead, not as a reason to replace libdxfrw's record-level soft-error behavior.

evidence.topic: Open CAD Studio route identity and 3D claim boundary
evidence.observed: Open CAD Studio currently advertises native DWG/DXF read/write through R14–2018, 3D modeling, kernel-backed operations, and ACIS-entity tessellation, while warning that the application remains under active development. ACadRust identifies Open CAD Studio as a user of its file engine. These pages establish a relevant consumer route and shared parser lineage, not independent runtime evidence.
doesNotEstablish: AutoCAD or other native-CAD acceptance of generated files
lossless handling of all supported entities or graph records
complete ACIS decoding, closed B-rep validity or exact shape semantics
evidence.planUse: Retain only the existing optional same-lineage consumer checkpoint. Pin app, codec and kernel revisions; record requested/actual version, hashes, warnings, repairs/synthesized records, per-object loss and tessellation fallback/incomplete status. App open/render does not qualify parser or B-rep semantics.

evidence.topic: uncad parser split and output scope
evidence.observed: uncad describes itself as read-only. Its DWG path uses LibreDWG via FFI; its DXF path uses the separate undxf crate; outputs are model, JSON, SVG or PNG projections rather than CAD write/conversion. Its model exposes header unit presence.
doesNotEstablish: source graph or opaque-record preservation from rendered output
evidence.planUse: Keep uncad classified as LibreDWG-lineage for DWG; consider undxf only in the existing optional DXF parser/projection lane at an exact pinned version. Add no new gate.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG documents stable, unstable, debugging and unhandled class states, with caveats that unstable/unknown object content can be converted to placeholders or preserved only under narrow same-version/raw-blob conditions.
doesNotEstablish: per-class parity from aggregate project coverage
typed support from placeholder or opaque preservation
evidence.planUse: Keep comparator outcomes normalized by route, version, class/family and disposition; record typed, opaque-preserved, skipped, rejected, repaired and failed outcomes separately.

optionalDwgRsReceiptFields: exact source commit and dependency graph
exact input hashes and per-version corpus manifest
per-version/per-family decoded, skipped, errored and boundary-checked counts
object-graph and unsupported disposition where exposed
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: Use only existing repository fixtures or locally generated scratch drawings; do not fetch or commit the peer's corpus.
implementationReadiness.cadence: No per-slice run or mandatory Rust/application dependency. One optional composed checkpoint only after source and runtime pinning; fast implementation loop remains unchanged.
implementationReadiness.acadrustApplicationPolicy: Open CAD Studio remains same-parser-lineage consumer evidence; pin codec/kernel and capture repairs, object loss and tessellation fallbacks independently.
